Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I received emails from the University of Copenhagen and the University of Oslo. At first it was a bit overwhelming and there is a lot of paperwork to send back and forth, but when you take one thing at a time it goes very well.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: You can send emails to KU, where you get a quick response. However, I think it's a shame that there is no contact number. There could well be.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Very succesfull

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do it in good time. Be patient.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I have been on a clinical rotation, and the healthcare system is very similar to Denmark. It was top class with skilled doctors and academic level. super nice

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Almost the same. I was very well received in the various departments, and was allowed to follow and work with senior doctors, very skilled. It was fantastic to be involved and the doctors were very willing to learn from me. In Denmark you are a bit more "a nuisance" during the clinic, or so you can feel. It was the opposite in Norway.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Clinical rotation. I have been to: orthopedic surgery department, thoracic surgery department, pediatric surgery department, radiology department and anesthesia department.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: All the rotations; orthopedic surgery department, thoracic surgery department, pediatric surgery department, radiology department and anesthesia department. The doctors was very good, and there is a big learning potential. I was allowed to assist in surgeries, see wild and rare surgeries, see patients independently in the policlinic, and do visit.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Search for everything in good time, find accommodation in good time. Be open in the clinic and ask questions, say what you want to do openly, take initiative. And go for long walks in nature.
